title: Installation Services in Jacó | MA Soluciones
description: Installation services in Jacó: kitchens, bathrooms, equipment, awnings and furniture. Professional assembly for villas and businesses. 48 h quotes.
lead: We install kitchens, bathroom fixtures, equipment, shutters, awnings and furniture in Jacó with the care of a full construction project: alignment, leveling and flawless finishes — ideal for rental villas and businesses that cannot wait.
heroAlt: Specialized installation work in a Jacó villa, Costa Rica
highlightsTitle: Installations that come out right the first time

highlights.title: Complete assembly
highlights.text: From cabinets and countertops to special equipment: one point of contact for the full setup of your property.

highlights.title: Clean work
highlights.text: We protect floors and furniture and leave the space ready to use the same day.

highlights.title: Around your schedule
highlights.text: We book short installation windows, respecting condo hours and business operations.

zoneLinkText: Jacó is the tourist and residential hub of the Central Pacific, between Garabito, Herradura and Playa Hermosa. We serve the area from our local base.

faqs.q: Do you install appliances and equipment?
faqs.a: Yes. We install stoves, beds, shutters, awnings, lamps and equipment requiring anchoring or special connections.

faqs.q: Can you work in a condo with restricted hours?
faqs.a: Yes. We coordinate with management on permitted hours and elevator or common-area access for moving materials.

faqs.q: How long does a typical installation take?
faqs.a: Most installations finish in one day. More complex jobs, like full kitchens, take 1 to 3 days.
